scope: independent root audit of the actual ordinary-j2 affine state normal form, degenerate localization, and characteristic-zero curve obstruction

mathematical_audit.normal_form: on the ell chart, direct centering makes D and T_ell unit multiples of c-c_star and H_m-Theta respectively; the diagonal Jacobian is a p-unit
mathematical_audit.ideal: the localized ideal is exactly (c-c_star,H-Theta), so connection-only elimination has zero intersection with the coefficient field and supplies no third divisor
mathematical_audit.degenerate_chart: when ell=0 and p>11, D forces mu=0; C nonzero would make b,v independent and f=0, contradicting the original affine vector equation, so every collision is supported on the r-only triple-minor content
mathematical_audit.zariski_density: the tail sqrt(2)-H_m is asymptotic to 2^(-m)/(sqrt(pi m)); ordering monomials by (2i-k,-k) gives a unique dominant term for every nonzero polynomial along every unbounded subsequence
mathematical_audit.actual_prime_subsequence: r=1 gives p=6m+11, and Dirichlet supplies an unbounded actual-prime subsequence, so fixed characteristic-zero state curves are excluded even there
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: moving finite-field/Frobenius relations and both weighted supports remain open; no fixed-curve obstruction is promoted to zero density

PROVED: unit Jacobian and full localized ideal
EXACT_FINITE_ONLY: generic, actual-row, Pluecker, and state controls
